probes.name: text
probes.source:
Sub Setup()
Dim f As Object
Range("B9:B10,K3:K5").Value2="z"
Range("K3").Value2="a"
Range("B9").Value2="a"
Set f=Range("B9:B10,K3:K5").FormatConditions.Add(9,String:="a",TextOperator:=0)
f.Font.Bold=True
End Sub
probes.inspection_source:
Function P(o As Object,k As String) As String
Dim v As Variant
On Error GoTo Failed
v=CallByName(o,k,VbGet)
If IsNull(v) Then
P="Null(1)"
ElseIf IsEmpty(v) Then
P="Empty(0)"
Else
P=CStr(v) & "(" & VarType(v) & ")"
End If
Exit Function
Failed:
P="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number)
End Function
Function RuleRange(f As Object) As String
On Error GoTo Failed
RuleRange=f.AppliesTo.Address
Exit Function
Failed:
RuleRange="ERR:" & CStr(Err.Number)
End Function
Function Held(f As Object) As String
Held="class=" & TypeName(f) & ";p=" & P(f,"Priority") & ";applies=" & RuleRange(f) & ";f1=" & P(f,"Formula1") & ";bold=" & P(f.Font,"Bold")
End Function
Function Snapshot() As String
Dim ws As Worksheet,f As Object,c As Range,k As Variant,s As String
For Each ws In ActiveWorkbook.Worksheets
s=s & "SHEET[" & ws.Name & "]count=" & CStr(ws.Cells.FormatConditions.Count)
For Each f In ws.Cells.FormatConditions
s=s & "|RULE[class=" & TypeName(f) & ";applies=" & RuleRange(f)
For Each k In Array("Type","Priority","StopIfTrue","Formula1","Formula2","Operator","Rank","Percent","TopBottom","AboveBelow","NumStdDev","DupeUnique","Text","TextOperator","DateOperator")
s=s & ";" & CStr(k) & "=" & P(f,CStr(k))
Next
s=s & ";bold=" & P(f.Font,"Bold") & ";italic=" & P(f.Font,"Italic") & ";fill=" & P(f.Interior,"Color") & ";bottom=" & P(f.Borders(xlBottom),"Color") & ";nf=" & P(f,"NumberFormat") & "]"
Next
s=s & "|CELLS["
For Each c In ws.Range("A1:L10").Cells
s=s & c.Address(False,False) & ":" & P(c.DisplayFormat.Font,"Bold") & "," & P(c.DisplayFormat.Interior,"Color") & "," & c.Text & ";"
Next
s=s & "]"
Next
Snapshot=s
End Function
Function Probe() As String
Dim f As Object,c As Range,s As String
Set f=ActiveSheet.Cells.FormatConditions(1)
s="applies=" & f.AppliesTo.Address & ";formula=" & P(f,"Formula1")
For Each c In Range("K3:K5,B9:B10")
s=s & ";" & c.Address(False,False) & "=" & CStr(c.DisplayFormat.Font.Bold)
Next
Probe=s
End Function
